name: Harbour Hotel
accommodation: Six individually named rooms, each with a private balcony and harbour or sea views
beachAccess: Steps from Newquay Harbour; beaches within easy reach
confirmedFeatures: En-suite rooms, Wi-Fi, restaurant and bar
overview: A small hotel on North Quay Hill, just steps from Newquay Harbour, with six individually named rooms. Each room has a private balcony and harbour or sea views. The Harbour Fish & Grill restaurant and bar is open to guests and non-residents, and Towan Beach is nearby.
surfTripFit: A quiet, central base close to the harbour and the waves at Towan.
